title: Fix next-week availability registration and audit schedule page

completed: static review of manager registration action, publication guards, timezone boundaries and DOM panel ownership
notes: GitHub connector does not expose a runnable checkout or browser.
Manual next-week registration now opens on the first action and is protected by backend lifecycle/publication guards.
The large manager schedule component still mixes some lazy auto-schedule error state with availability panel props; runtime validation is required before claiming the entire page is error-free.
Staff scheduling policy query still relies on fallback values for probation/contract rows, and autoCreateWindow has no scheduler implementation in this task.
No migration was added for historical availability windows created with old noncanonical timezone boundaries.
